name: Copy off this machine
title: Copy off this machine: once a week, this whole Rouh, its code included, locked with a password and sent to Cloudflare R2 or Amazon S3

permissions: sends one locked copy of this whole Rouh a week to the bucket its administrator set up here, and deletes its own older copies there (eight are kept)
lists the bucket, and writes and deletes one small file in it, when it is set up, to check the keys
accounts: the owner's own Cloudflare R2 or Amazon S3 bucket, with a token for that bucket only
jobs: the weekly copy off this machine (rouh/runtime.py, _offsite_loop), from the newest nightly copy of the database
touches.remove: Delete rouh/offsite_setup.py, rouh/web/backups.py, rouh/static/backupspage.*, rouh/static/app/offsite_ask.js and its import in app.js, the backups section in rouh/templates/rouh/index.html, its routes in rouh/project/urls.py, its line in rouh/anatomy.py and this manifest. The weekly copy itself (rouh/offsite.py) and the copies in the bucket stay.
